text.p: These are the leading stories in the Turkish press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Turkey celebrates Republic Day, the anniversary of founding of modern Turkey in 1923 as a secular republic.
- Istanbul airport's radar system goes down 90 minutes causing air traffic chaos.
- Prosecutor investigates daughter of late president Turgut Ozal over alleged corruption.
- Armed forces chief promises to protect secularism and democracy in his Republic Day message.
- Journalists' Association slams laws against freedom of expression.
- Turkey not even on U.N. list of countries attracting foreign investment.
- Rival Iraqi Kurdish groups to meet for peace talks in Ankara.
- Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan says Turks will be allowed to go on the Moslem Hajj pilgrimage to Mecca overland through Iraq this year for the first time in years.
